about: Every key minutes_create.py reads from the data file of minutes. The builder stops on a key that is not here, and on a value of another shape (skills/_shared/spec_guard.py). What was reported or noted under an item of business goes in that item's notes; a fact about the meeting as a whole that has no field of its own goes in the top-level notes, printed before the first item.

hints.company: the company or body that met is "body"
hints.company_name: the company or body that met is "body"
hints.organisation: the company or body that met is "body"
hints.location: where the meeting was held is "place"
hints.venue: where the meeting was held is "place"
hints.apologies: those who sent apologies go in "absent", a list of names
hints.attendees: members present go in "present", others in "in_attendance", both lists of names
hints.quorum_met: write "quorum": true to record that a quorum was present; the number a quorum needs goes in "notes"
hints.notice_given: that notice was given goes in "notes", a list of lines printed before the first item
hints.next_meeting: the next meeting is an item of business: add it to "items" with its date in the item's "notes"
hints.items.description: what was reported or noted under an item goes in the item's "notes"
hints.items.text: what was reported or noted under an item goes in the item's "notes"
hints.items.discussion: what was reported or noted under an item goes in the item's "notes"
hints.items.summary: what was reported or noted under an item goes in the item's "notes"
hints.items.resolution: a resolution goes in the item's "decisions", a list: ["that ..."] or [{"text": "that ...", "for": ["..."], "against": ["..."], "abstained": ["..."]}]
hints.items.resolutions: resolutions go in the item's "decisions", a list
hints.items.decision: a decision goes in the item's "decisions", a list: ["that ..."]
hints.items.number: items are numbered in the order they are given; leave the number out
hints.items.votes_for: who voted for goes with the decision: "decisions": [{"text": "that ...", "for": ["..."], "against": ["..."], "abstained": ["..."]}]
hints.items.votes_against: who voted against goes with the decision: "decisions": [{"text": "that ...", "for": ["..."], "against": ["..."], "abstained": ["..."]}]
hints.items.abstained: who abstained goes with the decision: "decisions": [{"text": "that ...", "for": ["..."], "against": ["..."], "abstained": ["..."]}]
hints.items.action: who is to do what goes in the item's "notes"
